_comment: The CI runners: one entry per registered Forgejo Actions runner, the single
declared source for name, host, labels, scope, capacity, and unit. Consumers:
nixos/ringtail/configuration.nix reads the ringtail instances (name, labels,
capacity); darwin/indri/configuration.nix renders the collector's capacity
lines; mise-tasks/forge-reconcile derives the privileged-label policy and
checks runs-on drift; docs/how-to/runbooks/runbook-forgejo-ci.md's table is
checked against the names and units here.
scope is the live forgejo_ci_runner_info{scope=...} label: `instance` or a
full owner/repo.
Git constraint: the nix consumers read this file by path from a git checkout
(ringtail: /etc/blumeops, indri: /etc/blumeops). It stops being read silently
if it is untracked or the apply runs from a non-checkout — the eval then
references a path that does not exist and fails loudly, but do not move it
out of the repo root tree.
The indri-runner and indri-build instances are declared here, and the
indri flake's generation consumes them: darwin/indri/configuration.nix
renders the main runner's config.yaml from the first (eblume/blumeops#1528)
and the build runner's config.yaml and colima profile from the second in
postActivation (eblume/blumeops#1627).
label_exceptions lists (repo, label-base) pairs whose workflows target no
live runner — exempt from the drift checks until the workflow is fixed.
Delete the entry once the workflow is retired.
